Munich

Our home base, and the natural first and last night of an alpine week.

Plan a trip to Munich

In short

Munich at a glance.

Munich is where EverFlow is based. Most of our guests fly in here, and the mountains begin about an hour south of the city.

Region
Bavaria, Germany
Airport
Munich (MUC)
To the mountains
About 1.5 hours by car to Garmisch-Partenkirchen
Best for
Arrival and departure days, culture, a city night before or after the snow

Who is it for?

For guests who want a day of museums, beer halls or shopping before heading into the mountains, and for anyone who lands late and wants a good night's sleep before the drive.

When to go?

All year. In winter a city night fits easily at the start or end of a ski week; the Christmas markets run through Advent.

How do you get there?

Munich Airport has direct flights from across Europe and overseas. From the airport, the city centre is about 40 to 45 minutes by train or car.
